description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPI' within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It handles scheduling, retrieving, and updating candidate interviews, including validation rules, transaction management, and interaction with data entities such as Interview, CandidateVacancy, and CandidateHistory. The class provides methods for creating and updating interview records, enforcing business rules such as maximum allowed interviews per candidate per vacancy.
